# Running a simulation {.unnumbered}

*This chapter describes how to launch a run — the scribe-mode I/O model, how to
size it, and the `run_schism_vm.sh` launcher that wraps the whole workflow.*

## Pre-run checklist

A run directory must contain a complete input set before launching:

- **Mesh & vertical grid:** `hgrid.gr3`, `hgrid.ll`, `vgrid.in`
- **Initial conditions:** `elev.ic`, `salt.ic`, `temp.ic` (+ tracer ICs)
- **Spatial flags / coefficients:** the `*.gr3` fields, `fluxflag.prop`, `tvd.prop`
- **Boundary forcing:** `bctides.in`, `*.th` / `elev2D.th.nc`, `TEM_*.th`, `AED_*.th`
- **Atmospheric forcing:** the `sflux/` directory + `sflux_inputs.txt`
- **Rivers / point sources:** `source_sink.in`, `vsource.th`, `msource.th`
- **Configuration:** `param.nml`, `aed.nml`, and the `aed/` parameter CSVs
- **Output dir:** an `outputs/` directory for SCHISM to write into

Each file is described in [Directory & file structure](../part2-model-setup/05-file-structure.qmd).

## Launching with mpirun

SCHISM uses **scribe-mode I/O**: a subset of MPI ranks is reserved to write
NetCDF output while the rest do computation. The integer after the binary name
is `NSCRIBE`, the number of scribe ranks:

```bash
mpirun -np <NPROC> pschism_AED <NSCRIBE>
```

- `NPROC` — total MPI ranks (compute + scribe)
- `NSCRIBE` — ranks reserved for scribe-I/O
- **compute ranks** = `NPROC − NSCRIBE`

### Sizing NSCRIBE

As a rule of thumb, **`NSCRIBE` ≈ the number of scribed-variable types** (one per
hydro/tracer variable) is a safe upper bound. Too low and the scribe ranks
bottleneck; too high and compute capacity is wasted.

| Total ranks | Reasonable NSCRIBE | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 16 | 4 | small test runs |
| 36 | 24 | ~one scribe per tracer |
| 64 | 24–26 | most ranks free for compute |
| 144+ | 24–48 | large HPC runs |

The Pioneer runs use **`NPROC = 64`, `NSCRIBE = 26`** — the 26 reflects the
scribed-variable count with the `GEN_1` tracer adding one.

## The `run_schism_vm.sh` launcher

The Pioneer runs ship with [`run_schism_vm.sh`](../../../runs/002_P18_flood/run_schism_vm.sh),
a no-SLURM wrapper that runs the model, checks the exit code, runs the combine
step, and reports timings — all in one go. Run it from the run directory:

```bash
./run_schism_vm.sh
# or override any knob at invocation:
NPROC=32 NSCRIBE=8 ./run_schism_vm.sh
```

Key environment knobs (all have sensible defaults):

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `NPROC` | 64 | total MPI ranks |
| `NSCRIBE` | 26 | scribe ranks |
| `BINARY` | (abs path) | the `pschism_AED` executable |
| `DO_COMBINE` | 1 | run the combine step after a clean exit |
| `COMBINE_ONLY` | 0 | skip SCHISM, just combine existing stacks |
| `HEARTBEAT_ON` | 1 | print a progress line every `HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL` s |

The combine-related knobs are covered in
[Combining outputs & health checks](19-combining-and-health-checks.qmd).

::: {.callout-tip}
Run under `tmux` or `nohup ./run_schism_vm.sh > run.log 2>&1 &` for long runs.
The heartbeat prints the latest `mirror.out` timestep and a real:sim time ratio,
so you can see the model advancing without tailing the log.
:::

## Run length & output cadence

Run length and I/O cadence are set in `param.nml` — `rnday` (days), `dt`
(timestep, s), `nspool` (output every N steps), and `ihfskip` (steps per output
stack). The Pioneer runs use `rnday = 91`, `dt = 45 s`, 15-minute output spooled
into daily stacks. See [Run scenarios & log](20-run-scenarios-and-log.qmd) for
the per-run settings.
